strategy_question: How should canonical L03 foundational-interrogative OPI slots be identified before any OPI authoring, given that no independent slot-ID inventory has been established in this workstream?

routes.name: SOURCE_LOCK_L03_FOUNDATIONAL_OPI_SLOT_MODEL_BEFORE_AUTHORING
routes.reason: Identify or explicitly define the canonical slot model from authoritative curriculum evidence before assigning IDs or writing OPI items.

routes.name: INVENT_SEQUENTIAL_OPI_IDS_AND_AUTHOR_NOW
routes.reason: Would fabricate slot identity and collapse slot governance into authoring.

routes.name: UNLOCK_ALL_TEN_OPI_FOR_FREE_AUTHORING
routes.reason: Would exceed the bounded two-realization source mapping and bypass per-slot provenance.

constraints: No synthetic OPI slot IDs in strategy selection.
No OPI text authoring or validation in strategy selection.
The existing curriculum-source mapping remains limited to VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE.
No subject/person, tense/aspect or copula inference; no KE generalization.
